predecessors.name: Xin dynasty
predecessors.text: 'roved through large swaths of territory in modern southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu' (Wang Mang page): a 150 km disc round Linyi and a 100 km disc round Xuzhou, limited to the cells the Xin…

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: Guanzhong, the Chimei's last holding, taken by Guangwu in 27

ledger.x: About 17: the Chimei rise in southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu.
About 17: the Chimei contest the Xin in southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu (Wang Mang page); a mirror of the xin-dynasty ledger.
23: the Xin ends with the Chimei undefeated in the east; they go on to take Guanzhong from the Gengshi regime (Guangwu page) and surrender in 27.
25: the Chimei take Guanzhong from the Gengshi regime.
25: Guangwu, proclaimed on 5 August 25 at Luoyang, takes the field against the Chimei in Guanzhong.
27: Guanzhong passes to Guangwu's Han with the Chimei's surrender.
27: the Chimei rebellion ends with the surrender at Yiyang.

wars.name: Lülin and Chimei rebellions (fall of the Xin)
wars.outcome: The rebels ended the Xin in October 23; the Chimei stayed in the field.

wars.name: Guangwu's war against the Chimei
wars.outcome: The Chimei, who held Guanzhong after deposing the Gengshi Emperor, were blockaded at Yiyang and surrendered in 27.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for the Chimei; Guanzhong is the Guangwu page's name for their last holding.
